title: Exercises

alerts.muscle_primary: Primary muscle already trained in this session
alerts.rest_48h: This muscle was trained less than 48 hours ago
alerts.cardio_conflict: Cardio conflict — same body region as previous exercise

form.video_dropzone: Drag a video or click to select
form.center_note: Usable right away in your gym. The WODBUD team will review it, then may add it to the shared library with an official video.
form.technique_required: Add the technique cues: they’re used for the review.
form.ref_hint: Show the movement to the WODBUD team (video up to 60 s, filmed on your phone). Private: only WODBUD sees it, to shoot the official video.
form.ref_upload_failed: The exercise is saved, but the media couldn’t be uploaded. {{reason}}
form.ref_error_too_big: File too large, even compressed. Try a shorter video.
form.ref_error_unsupported: Choose a photo or a video.
form.equipment_required: Choose the equipment, or “Bodyweight” if none is needed.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.subtitle: Manage descriptions and videos for all exercises.

detail.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.
detail.delete_confirm_text: Delete {{name}}? This can’t be undone and also removes its muscle links.

errors.auth_session_missing_exercise: Missing session: sign in again to create or edit an exercise.
errors.invalid_session_reconnect: Invalid session: sign in again to create an exercise.
errors.video_storage_not_configured: Video storage (Cloudflare R2) isn't set up yet.
errors.video_admin_required: Only an admin account can upload a video.
errors.video_upload_network: The transfer to storage failed. If it keeps happening, check the R2 bucket's CORS policy.

empty_hint: Add your exercises once — they feed every workout you build after that.
empty_filtered_hint: No exercise matches all these filters. Drop one to widen the search.

warnings.video_upload_skipped: Exercise saved, but the video wasn't uploaded. {{reason}}

review.title: Gym exercises to review
review.hint: Check the media, fix what’s needed, then publish to the shared library (the author is notified) or keep it in its gym. Reference media are deleted after the decision.
review.announced_one: Announcement sent: {{count}} new exercise this week.
review.announced_other: Announcement sent: {{count}} new exercises this week.
review.nothing_new: Nothing new this week: no announcement sent.
review.published: “{{name}}” is published in the shared library.
review.complete_first: Edit the exercise first: some information is missing.

import.title: Import exercises
import.sub_center: CSV, PDF or photos of your workout sheets
import.sub_admin: Into the shared library — CSV, PDF or photos of sheets
import.formats: Photos (JPG, PNG), PDF (each page is read) or CSV (columns: name, category, muscle, description, occurrences — only name is required).
import.nothing_found: No exercise found in these files.
import.explain: Names that repeat are merged (×N = times found). Those already in the library are linked instead of recreated; tick “Create anyway” if it’s a different exercise.
import.linked_exact: Already in the library: linked to “{{name}}”
import.linked_similar: Looks like “{{name}}”: linked. Tick to create anyway.
import.mentions_failed: Exercises imported, but the count couldn’t be saved. {{reason}}
import.center_review: Created exercises are usable right away in your gym; the WODBUD team will review them.

priorities.title: Videos to shoot first
priorities.hint: The exercises mentioned most in every gym’s imports, those without an official video first. Tap an exercise to attach its video.
priorities.empty: No imports yet: the list will fill up with the gyms’ imports.
priorities.all_done: Every mentioned exercise has its video.

links.title: Variations
links.explain_harder: The chosen exercise will be suggested when {{name}} gets too easy.
links.explain_easier: The chosen exercise will be suggested when {{name}} is too hard.
links.explain_adaptation: The chosen exercise will replace {{name}} when this area hurts.
